## Finding

A function that returns one struct variable from two `return` statements returns wrong bytes from
the second statement. It happens with `--model-medium`, `--model-large`, `--model-huge`, and
`--stack-auto`. The small model without `--stack-auto` is correct. The program attached to the ticket
reproduces it in ucsim: the four result bytes are `10 11 21 00`, and `10 11 20 21` is expected.

## Cause

The struct-return path of `genRet` in `src/mcs51/gen.c` jumps to `jumpret` without calling
`freeAsmop` for `IC_LEFT (ic)`. A later `return` of the same variable reuses the asmop of the first
`return`, including the DPTR offset at which the first copy ended. The code then calls `__decdptr`
where it must load the address again, and it reads from the address that DPTR holds at that point.

## Fix

`genRet` calls `freeAsmop (IC_LEFT (ic), NULL, ic, true)` before the jump. The patch attached to
the ticket makes the same change.

## Verification

Without the patch, `support/regression/tests/bug-4158.c` fails on r17176 for every mcs51 variant
except mcs51-small: 2 of its 10 assertions for mcs51-medium and 6 for the others. It passes with
the patch. The patch does
not change the assembly generated for the other regression tests.
